description_excerpt: The Key Account Manager owns a defined portfolio of strategic accounts and selected major opportunities across Vietnam’s power-generation ecosystem. The role drives profitable growth in conventional generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage systems (BESS), electrical balance of plant, grid connection, modernization and lifecycle services. The role is accountable for account development, early opportunity shaping, qualified pipeline growth, commercial coordination and customer governance.
